title: Food limits a toy habitat
hook: A model can tie capacity to an explicit resource rule.

knows: Animals interact with other organisms and their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: In a toy model each animal needs one food unit and no other resources limit survival. How many animals can 8 food units support?

misconception: One observation or model rule gives a complete answer about nature.
objective: In a toy model each animal needs one food unit and no other resources limit survival. How many animals can 8 food units support?

claims.text: In a toy model each animal needs one food unit and no other resources limit survival. How many animals can 8 food units support? Under the stipulated one-unit-per-animal rule, 8 food units support at most 8 animals in this toy model. Real carrying capacity depends on many conditions and can change over time.
claims.source: Unverified reference lead for independent check: OpenStax Biology 2e, ecology and populations, https://openstax.org/details/books/biology-2e . Exact claim-specific sources have not been verified.

claims.text: The panels depict a simplified illustrative scenario, not observations or measurements of real animals.
Under the same toy rule, each animal needs two food units. What is the maximum for 10 food units? 10 food units divided by 2 per animal gives 5.
